title: Deaths of migrants in ICE custody hit record high under Trump
summary: Twenty-nine people have died in ICE custody since October, the start of the federal government's fiscal year, already surpassing 2004's toll of 28, the previous record, according to government data.
contentText:
Twenty-nine people have died in ICE custody since October, the start of the federal government's fiscal year, already surpassing 2004's toll of 28, the previous record, according to government data.

(Image credit: Sergio Martínez-Beltrán)
